components_to_create.purpose: Sticky top bar + main navigation with brand logo, live search modal trigger, favorites counter, user account popover, and cart drawer trigger.
Comprehensive footer with brand narrative, category links, trust badges (Pix, Visa, Mastercard, Compra Segura SSL), newsletter signup, and social links.
Hero banner with warm luxury backdrop, headline 'Presentes que transformam momentos em memórias', subtext, dual CTAs, trust pill tags, and floating review card.
10 curated category cards with subtle borders, images, category tags, item count, and smooth hover elevation.
'Mais amados' product showcase with badge, price, installments (até 6x), 2-image hover transition, favorite toggle, and quick add-to-cart.
'Seu presente. Do seu jeito.' interactive customizer banner with photo composition and 'Quero Personalizar' CTA.
4-step minimalist visual timeline: 01 Escolha -> 02 Personalize -> 03 Finalize -> 04 Receba com afeto.
Emotional occasion cards ('Quero presentear minha mãe', 'Surpreender meu amor', 'Padrinhos de Casamento', etc.).
'Quem recebe, ama.' customer reviews with avatar, 5 stars, verified purchase badge, and real recipient photos.
'Momentos que viraram presentes' live instagram grid layout with @giftsdano CTA.
4 trust pillars: Feito à mão com afeto, Envio seguro para todo Brasil, Personalização exclusiva, Atendimento humanizado no WhatsApp.
Slide-over cart sheet with quantity controls, CEP calculator with Sedex/PAC estimates, coupon input, subtotal, and 'Finalizar Compra' CTA.
Instant fuzzy search modal with instant results, recent searches, category shortcuts, and price previews.
Floating WhatsApp button with customized tooltip 'Fale com a nossa equipe de presentes personalizadas'.
Shop / Catalog with multi-filter (price range, occasion, category, recipient), sorting, active tags, and grid/list toggle.

High-conversion product page with 4-image interactive gallery, zoom, live preview for personalized text / recipient name, photo upload dropzone, installments breakdown, CEP shipping calculator, and related products.
Step-by-step custom gift builder (Box -> Presente Base -> Personalização de Gravação/Texto -> Fita/Embalagem -> Cartão com Mensagem).
Clean 5-step simulated checkout (Identificação, Endereço com busca de CEP, Frete, Pagamento Pix com QR Code mock + Cartão simulado, Confirmação com número do pedido).
Dedicated wishlist page with saved gifts and quick batch actions.
Brand heritage, mission 'Afetos que encantam', atelier process, and quality commitment.
Contact hub, corporate gift inquiry form, FAQ accordion, and workshop location/hours.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retheme `frontend/src/index.css` by importing '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', and '@fontsource-variable/geist-mono', and setting `--font-heading: 'Playfair Display Variable', serif;` and `--font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif;`.
Configure background color to `#FAF8F5` (warm delicate off-white) and primary accent to `#0B1528` (deep navy from the official logo).

Use the official logo image URL: `https://customer-assets-rejwkqb3.emergentagent.net/job_4549265b-f990-4a2f-a690-f52f74538705/artifacts/0b2c9df89d0ee5ae_WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-30%20at%2011.13.08.jpeg` in the header, footer, and checkout navigation.

Implement full mock and interactive state management for Cart, Wishlist, Search, Customizer, and 5-step Checkout (supporting simulated Pix with dynamic QR code & copy-paste code, and Credit Card simulation with installment calculator up to 6x sem juros).
Ensure all copy is in fluent, elegant Brazilian Portuguese with emotional, sophisticated tone (e.g., 'Afetos que Encantam', 'Presentes com Alma', 'Produzido com Carinho').
Every clickable or interactive element must have a clear `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-add-to-cart'`, `data-testid='input-personalization-name'`).
Provide a simulated backend seed script (`backend/seed.py`) with rich product catalog data matching the categories and products defined in these guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered Bootstrap-like layouts; use sophisticated asymmetric grids, generous padding (p-6 to p-12), and delicate 1px borders (#EDE8E1).
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖🧠💡. Use clean Lucide icons (Heart, ShoppingBag, Sparkles, Gift, Truck, ShieldCheck, Clock, MessageCircle, Star, Search, User, Filter, Share2).
Always provide immediate tactile feedback on interactions (subtle scale down on click, smooth image opacity transition on card hover).
Ensure total contrast compliance: dark navy text (#0B1528 / #1E242B) on off-white (#FAF8F5 / #FFFFFF) exceeds 10:1 ratio.
Use Sonner for toast notifications on actions like 'Item adicionado ao carrinho!', 'Salvo nos favoritos', and 'Cupom AFETO10 aplicado!'.
